verdict.rationale: Copilot generates code suggestions, completions, chat answers, and Autofix vulnerability suggestions directly from the user's own codebase/context (docs-1,2,9,13,22), and community feedback corroborates it delivering genuinely useful, context-aware suggestions in practice (comm-1,6,7). missing for 10: independent benchmarking of suggestion quality/accuracy and more consistent positive real-world validation given mixed community sentiment on correctness (comm-2,8,10).
